title: Gravity Room web: desktop shell, Hoy y Entrenar
brief: Own desktop interface for the Gravity Room web app (not a phone layout with a sidebar). One navigation model, a desktop Home (Hoy) and a desktop workout logger (Entrenar). Keep and polish the current industrial identity: gold on warm black, Bebas Neue + Barlow + JetBrains Mono.

artboards.title: 01 · Centro de mando
artboards.tradeoff: Dense, keyboard-first and fast for regular lifters; heavier first impression and more to learn

artboards.title: 02 · Foco en la sesión
artboards.tradeoff: Guided and calm, one lift at a time; less overview of the week and the whole session at once

artboards.title: 03 · Cuaderno de hierro
artboards.tradeoff: Strongest brand unity with the landing and program-first; fewer dashboard metrics and a bolder, less neutral look
